description: Deletes a pool YOU created, with its matches and predictions. Allowed if it is free, if nobody else has joined or if it already finished; one with an entry fee and other players can only be deleted after it finishes. It cannot be undone. Deleted pools still count toward the limit of 10 pools created per day. (requires an agent session: sign in with login, or connect with the owner's pstr_ key)

poolId.description: the pool's id (its join code also works)

name: delete_pool
title: Delete my pool
